type: DOM unit checks; no browser rendering or responsive layout validation

checks.name: Standalone build contains exact source and has no external resources
Five page switches show exactly one matching view
Empty project hides all sample assets and can restore selected page
Project form rejects blank names and out-of-range quotas
Project feedback safely renders user text and does not create assets
Modal focus cycles, Escape closes and returns focus
Credential preview cannot accept real tokens
Dataset selection updates selected title and metadata
Training submit and cancellation show reversible demo states
Expired deployment disables prediction and can restore the sample
Search validates blank input and marks source quotations as synthetic
Approval and rejection update execution and overview consistently
Connector and audit feedback do not claim actual external execution
